passages.text: Again the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I am jealous for Zion with great zeal; I am jealous for her with great fervor.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to me again.
The LORD of Hosts is God over all armies and powers.
He said these words.
The LORD of Hosts said, “I am jealous for Zion.
I have great zeal for Zion.
I am jealous for her with great fervor.
My jealousy for Zion is strong and passionate.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת קִנֵּ֥אתִי לְצִיּ֖וֹן קִנְאָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְחֵמָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה קִנֵּ֥אתִי לָֽהּ׃

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD says, “I will return to Zion.
I will live in Jerusalem.
People will call Jerusalem the City of Truth.
People will call the mountain of the LORD of Hosts the Holy Mountain.”
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַׁ֚בְתִּי אֶל־ צִיּ֔וֹן וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּת֣וֹךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְנִקְרְאָ֤ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עִ֣יר־ הָֽאֱמֶ֔ת וְהַר־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת הַ֥ר הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts is powerful and commands armies.
He says this:
Old men will sit in the streets of Jerusalem again.
Old women will also sit in the streets of Jerusalem again.
Each person will have a staff in hand.
They will hold a staff because they are very old.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עֹ֤ד יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ זְקֵנִ֣ים וּזְקֵנ֔וֹת בִּרְחֹב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאִ֧ישׁ מִשְׁעַנְתּ֛וֹ בְּיָד֖וֹ מֵרֹ֥ב יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing there.”
passages.sermon:
The city has many streets.
Boys will fill the streets.
Girls will fill the streets.
Boys will play in the streets.
Girls will play in the streets.
passages.original: וּרְחֹב֤וֹת הָעִיר֙ יִמָּ֣לְא֔וּ יְלָדִ֖ים וִֽילָד֑וֹת מְשַׂחֲקִ֖ים בִּרְחֹֽבֹתֶֽיהָ׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?” declares the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts has great power and authority.
Some people remain in Jerusalem after trouble.
These people are called the remnant.
The remnant sees something.
They think it is impossible.
This happens in their own days.
The LORD of Hosts asks a question.
He says, “Is it also impossible for Me?”
The LORD of Hosts declares this.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת כִּ֣י יִפָּלֵ֗א בְּעֵינֵי֙ שְׁאֵרִית֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם גַּם־ בְּעֵינַי֙ יִפָּלֵ֔א נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts is powerful and commands armies.
The LORD of Hosts says this.
He will save His people.
He will save them from the land of the east.
He will save them from the land of the west.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִ֥י מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִזְרָ֑ח וּמֵאֶ֖רֶץ מְב֥וֹא הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: I will bring them back to dwell in Jerusalem, where they will be My people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts is powerful and commands armies.
He says, “I will bring My people back.
I will bring them to live in Jerusalem.
They will be My people.
I will be their God.
I will be faithful to them.
I will act with righteousness toward them.”
passages.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם וְשָׁכְנ֖וּ בְּת֣וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְהָיוּ־ לִ֣י לְעָ֗ם וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת וּבִצְדָקָֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Let your hands be strong, you who now hear these words spoken by the prophets who were present when the foundations were laid to rebuild the temple, the house of the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is the God of heavenly armies.
He commands great power and authority.
He says, “Let your hands be strong.
You are the people who hear these words today.
You hear the words spoken by the prophets.
These prophets were present long ago.
They spoke when the foundations of the temple were laid.
The temple is the house of the LORD of Hosts.
The foundations were laid to rebuild it.
You who hear these words must be strong.”
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יְדֵיכֶ֔ם הַשֹּֽׁמְעִים֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֵ֖ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה מִפִּי֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲ֠שֶׁר בְּי֞וֹם יֻסַּ֨ד בֵּית־ יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת הַהֵיכָ֖ל לְהִבָּנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: For before those days neither man nor beast received wages, nor was there safety from the enemy for anyone who came or went, for I had turned every man against his neighbor.
passages.sermon:
Before those days, people did not receive wages.
Animals did not receive wages.
There was no safety for anyone who went out or came in.
Enemies threatened everyone.
I, the LORD, turned every person against his neighbor.
passages.original: כִּ֗י לִפְנֵי֙ הַיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם שְׂכַ֤ר הָֽאָדָם֙ לֹ֣א נִֽהְיָ֔ה וּשְׂכַ֥ר הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֵינֶ֑נָּה וְלַיּוֹצֵ֨א וְלַבָּ֤א אֵין־ שָׁלוֹם֙ מִן־ הַצָּ֔ר וַאֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָדָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּרֵעֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: But now I will not treat the remnant of this people as I did in the past,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He addresses the remnant of this people.
He says, "Now I act differently toward you."
I do not treat you as I did in former days.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לֹ֣א כַיָּמִ֤ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִים֙ אֲנִ֔י לִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: “For the seed will be prosperous, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will yield its produce, and the skies will give their dew. To the remnant of this people I will give all these things as an inheritance.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the remnant of His people.
God promises blessing to them.
The seed will grow well.
The vine will give its fruit.
The ground will give its crops.
The skies will give their dew.
God will give all these blessings to the remnant of His people.
God will make these blessings their inheritance.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ זֶ֣רַע הַשָּׁל֗וֹם הַגֶּ֜פֶן תִּתֵּ֤ן פִּרְיָהּ֙ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת־ יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְהַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִתְּנ֣וּ טַלָּ֑ם וְהִנְחַלְתִּ֗י אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֛ית הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: As you have been a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks to the house of Judah and the house of Israel.
You were once a curse among the nations.
I will save you.
You will become a blessing.
Do not be afraid.
Let your hands be strong.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ הֱיִיתֶ֨ם קְלָלָ֜ה בַּגּוֹיִ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ וּבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֵּ֚ן אוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם בְּרָכָ֑ה אַל־ תִּירָ֖אוּ תֶּחֱזַ֥קְנָה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Just as I resolved to bring disaster upon you when your fathers provoked Me to anger, and I did not relent,” says the LORD of Hosts, “so now I have resolved to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
The LORD of Hosts has great power and authority.
The LORD of Hosts once decided to bring disaster upon you.
Your fathers made Me angry.
I did not change My mind.
Now, in these days, I have decided to do good to Jerusalem and to Judah.
Do not be afraid.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר זָמַמְ֜תִּי לְהָרַ֣ע לָכֶ֗ם בְּהַקְצִ֤יף אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ אֹתִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְלֹ֖א נִחָֽמְתִּי׃ כֵּ֣ן שַׁ֤בְתִּי זָמַ֙מְתִּי֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְהֵיטִ֥יב אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְאֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אַל־ תִּירָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates, do not plot evil in your hearts against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely, for I hate all these things,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks to the people of Judah and Israel.
He gives clear commands.
These are the things you must do.
Speak truth to one another.
Judge with truth and peace in your gates.
Do not plan evil in your heart against your neighbor.
Do not love false oaths.
The LORD hates all these things.
passages.original: אֵ֥לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּֽעֲשׂ֑וּ דַּבְּר֤וּ אֱמֶת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֔הוּ אֱמֶת֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣ט שָׁל֔וֹם שִׁפְט֖וּ בְּשַׁעֲרֵיכֶֽם׃ וְאִ֣ישׁ׀ אֶת־ רָעַ֣ת רֵעֵ֗הוּ אַֽל־ תַּחְשְׁבוּ֙ בִּלְבַבְכֶ֔ם וּשְׁבֻ֥עַת שֶׁ֖קֶר אַֽל־ תֶּאֱהָ֑בוּ כִּ֧י אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖אתִי נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying, “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: The fasts of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the tenth months will become times of joy and gladness, cheerful feasts for the house of Judah. Therefore you are to love both truth and peace.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to me.
The LORD of Hosts is God over all armies and powers.
He said these words to me.
The LORD of Hosts said, “The fasts of the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, and the tenth month will change.
These fasts will become times of joy for the house of Judah.
They will become times of gladness.
They will become cheerful feasts.
You must love truth.
You must love peace.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֛י דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צ֣וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֡י וְצ֣וֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי֩ וְצ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י וְצ֣וֹם הָעֲשִׂירִ֗י יִהְיֶ֤ה לְבֵית־ יְהוּדָה֙ לְשָׂשׂ֣וֹן וּלְשִׂמְחָ֔ה וּֽלְמֹעֲדִ֖ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְהָאֱמֶ֥ת וְהַשָּׁל֖וֹם אֱהָֽבוּ׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Peoples will yet come—the residents of many cities— and the residents of one city will go to another, saying: ‘Let us go at once to plead before the LORD and to seek the LORD of Hosts. I myself am going.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is the God who commands heaven’s armies.
He says that people will come.
Many people from many nations will come.
People who live in many cities will come.
Residents of one city will go to another city.
They will say, “Let us go at once.
Let us go to plead before the LORD.
Let us seek the LORD of Hosts.
I myself am going.”
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת עֹ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבֹ֣אוּ עַמִּ֔ים וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י עָרִ֥ים רַבּֽוֹת׃ וְֽהָלְכ֡וּ יֹשְׁבֵי֩ אַחַ֨ת אֶל־ אַחַ֜ת לֵאמֹ֗ר נֵלְכָ֤ה הָלוֹךְ֙ לְחַלּוֹת֙ אֶת־ פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אֵלְכָ֖ה גַּם־ אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: And many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Hosts in Jerusalem and to plead before the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God over all.
Many peoples will come to Jerusalem.
Strong nations will also come to Jerusalem.
They will seek the LORD of Hosts in Jerusalem.
They will plead before the LORD.
passages.original: וּבָ֨אוּ עַמִּ֤ים רַבִּים֙ וְגוֹיִ֣ם עֲצוּמִ֔ים לְבַקֵּ֛שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּלְחַלּ֖וֹת אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “In those days ten men from the nations of every tongue will tightly grasp the robe of a Jew, saying, ‘Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is speaking.
He is the God who commands armies.
He says what will happen in the future.
In those days, something special will happen.
Ten men will come from many nations.
These men will speak different languages.
They will each take hold of a Jew’s robe.
They will hold on tightly.
They will say, “Let us go with you.”
They will say this because they have heard something important.
They have heard that God is with the Jewish people.
passages.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַר֮ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל לְשֹׁנ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְֽהֶחֱזִ֡יקוּ בִּכְנַף֩ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדִ֜י לֵאמֹ֗ר נֵֽלְכָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים עִמָּכֶֽם׃ס
